summary: Customer produces a clear, colourless aqueous sucrose solution and wants in-line monitoring of sucrose concentration in a 50 mm stainless steel pipe (20 to 30 °C, normal pressure, 5 to 15 % w/w, quality limit ±0.3 % w/w, one reading per minute). A laboratory refractometer remains the reference method. The analyser would sit in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe; the line is CIP-cleaned with hot caustic daily. They ask for a proposed method and probe for a first trial.
